about.title: About us
about.heroText: LidoRank is an independent civic project: bringing transparency to beaches worldwide with structured reviews and verifiable data, useful to citizens and to the authorities overseeing the maritime public domain.
about.giorgioBio: Italian engineer specialized in advanced artificial-intelligence systems for the aerospace and defense sector. He holds a BSc in Computer Science and an MSc in Artificial Intelligence (with honors) from Northeastern University London, and has collaborated with DESY researchers on quantum convolutional neural networks. His interests go beyond engineering, touching the social implications of AI — economics, political philosophy, the history of technological change. He is the author of the book AMAKOM: A Perpetual Peace for the Age of Robots.
about.francescoBio: Second-year Ph.D. student in Comparative Politics and Analytical Political Theory. He works on the Bolkestein Directive and collaborates on research with the municipalities of Livorno and Rosignano Marittimo. He investigates the effects of local social capital and the resistance/adaptation strategies to externally imposed neoliberal economic policies within European integration. Born in Pisa, he speaks four languages (Italian, English, Spanish and French). He holds an MA in Legal and Political Theory from University College London (UCL) and a BA in Economics and Finance from the University of Pisa.
about.p1: LidoRank started from a simple question: why is choosing a beach club still so opaque? Prices not always posted, sea access that should be free by law, family services and accessibility hard to compare. In the middle of the debate on concessions (the Bolkestein Directive), a neutral tool was missing.
about.p2: The idea is to combine two worlds: the rigor of public data (maritime-domain concessions) and the real experience of people (vertical reviews across nine criteria). An information base useful to citizens for choosing and to authorities for oversight.
about.p3: LidoRank was co-founded by Giorgio Menicagli Pirina and Francesco Mancuso. Giorgio leads product and engineering; Francesco leads policy analysis, research and institutional relations. Built also with the help of artificial-intelligence tools, under human supervision.

methodology.title: How the rankings work
methodology.intro: Transparency first: here's how LidoRank's scores and rankings are built, and why a ranking is sometimes shown as “in progress”.
methodology.s1Body: We don't publish fake or paid reviews. Every score comes from someone filling in the questionnaire across our nine criteria. Reviews from verified accounts count more than anonymous ones.
methodology.s2Title: A weighted score, not a plain average
methodology.s2Body: A ranking score isn't the plain average of the votes: we use a Bayesian weighted average that also accounts for how many reviews there are. With few votes the score stays cautious and close to the overall mean; as reviews grow, it increasingly reflects the real judgement. This way a club with a single enthusiastic review doesn't leapfrog one with dozens of solid ones.
methodology.s3Body: A club enters a ranking only after a minimum number of reviews: at least {comune} for the town ranking, {regione} for the regional one and {nazionale} for the national one. Below these thresholds we assign no position: we'd rather say “ranking in progress” than crown a “best” on the basis of very little data.
methodology.s4Body: Every review has a weight and a status. Rate limits, anti-surge checks and the option to flag a suspicious review reduce the risk of manipulation: anomalous votes are down-weighted or put on hold, without erasing the rights of good-faith reviewers.
methodology.s5Title: Objective facts kept separate from ratings
methodology.s5Body: On the profile we keep subjective ratings (your experience) separate from objective facts (sea access, showers, deposit chip). Facts are shown as aggregate percentages and do not, on their own, turn a club into “non-compliant”: any reports of violations follow a separate, private path.
methodology.disclaimer: LidoRank is a pilot-stage platform: thresholds and criteria may be refined as the community grows.
